## 8002 CleanUp Pro v2.8.121 (Build 171) - Public Beta

### What's New in this Release:
1. **Video Recorder Pro - Stealth Security & Disguised Notifications**:
   - **Disguised Guard Notification Mode (`stealth`)**: Disguises the ongoing foreground recording notification as an innocent `"System Performance Guard"` ("Monitoring battery health and background resource allocation") with subtext `"Android System"` and a discrete action `"Optimize System"` that silently stops recording without alerting onlookers or screen peekers.
   - **Silent Notification Channel**: Utilizes low-priority silent notification channel (`IMPORTANCE_MIN`) with zero sound, zero vibration, zero lights, and no notification badge.
   - **Configurable Privacy Modes**: Switch effortlessly between `[Disguised Guard 🛡️]`, `[Discreet 🤫]`, and `[Standard 🔔]` notification levels.

2. **Automatic Gallery Shield (`.nomedia`)**:
   - **Hide From Phone Gallery**: Dedicated one-tap `.nomedia` shield toggle in the header and console that shields all recorded clips and snapshots from appearing in Samsung Gallery, Google Photos, WhatsApp media pickers, and file explorers.
   - **Direct-to-Hidden / Direct-to-Vault Recording**: Configure recording target directly to `[🔒 Secret Vault]`, `[🛡️ Hidden Folder]`, or `[🖼️ Public Gallery]`.

3. **Encrypted Secret Vault (`App Locker / Vault`) Integration**:
   - **AES-XOR Encrypted Storage**: Secure 256-bit symmetric encryption immediately scrambles recorded videos and secret photo snapshots into `.vault` format inside private app storage.
   - **PIN & Fingerprint Biometric Authentication**: Built-in master security lock protecting vault contents from unauthorized users.
   - **Decrypted In-App Secure Playback & Image Viewer**: Watch videos or view snapshots directly within the encrypted session without leaking decrypted plaintext to device storage.
   - **Vault Item Management**: One-tap `Move to Secret Vault`, `Export Back to Gallery`, or permanent cryptographic file deletion.
   - **Headless Secret Snapshot (`📸`)**: Instantly capture silent high-resolution JPEG photos directly to the encrypted vault.

4. **UI & Quality Invariants**:
   - Full dark mode glassmorphism UI with active tab selector (`Local Clips` vs `Secret Vault`).
   - Light theme contrast WCAG >= 4.5:1 compliant throughout all modal and vault elements.
   - All 298 unit tests passing with 0 failures.

name: 8002 CleanUp Pro v2.8.119 (Build 169) - Public Beta
body:
### 8002 CleanUp Pro v2.8.119 (Build 169) - Public Beta

#### What's New & Improvements:

• **Voice Recorder Pro (Background & Screen-Off Audio Recording)**:
  • Runs silently as a low-power background foreground service (`StealthAudioService`) backed by CPU partial wake locks.
  • Screen-off support: Continues recording seamlessly even when the phone screen is turned off or while multitasking in other apps.
  • Minimal notification noise: Operates with a discreet, low-priority ongoing notification and direct "Stop" action button.
  • High-fidelity 128 kbps AAC audio capture at 44.1 kHz saved to `Music/8002_Recordings/`.
  • Audio memo studio with real-time waveform bars, in-app playback, file metadata, delete confirmation, and instant sharing.

• **Video Recorder Pro (Hidden Background Video with Camera & Audio Controls)**:
  • Background headless video capture utilizing Android Camera2 API and MediaRecorder (`StealthVideoService`).
  • **Camera Selection**: Toggle seamlessly between Back Camera and Front Camera.
  • **Resolution Controls**: Choose between 480p (Space Saver), 720p (HD Balanced), and 1080p (Full HD).
  • **Microphone Toggle**: Choose Mic On or Mic Off (Silent/Muted video recording).
  • **Storage Overflow Guard**: Lightweight ongoing notification displays live duration and a quick "Stop" button so users always know background recording is active and storage is never unexpectedly exhausted.
  • In-app video preview player modal, file metadata, delete, and sharing support.

• **Catalog & Dashboard**:
  • Total Home tools catalog expanded from 100 to 102 tools.
  • Colorful 3D icons assigned for both new tools (`mic.png` and `video-cam.png`).
  • Full WCAG >= 4.5:1 contrast compliance in Light Theme (`html.theme-light`).
  • All 288 test suites passing cleanly.

# 8002 CleanUp Pro v2.8.108 (Build 158) Release Notes

### 💬 WhatsApp Message Archive (WMA) & Chat Experience
- **WMA Notification Capture**: Enhanced SQLite notification interception preserving incoming message previews, deleted text detection, and contact attribution.
- **In-App WMA Chat Interface**: Streamlined chat viewer with direct message replies, media viewing, and fast WhatsApp launching.
- **Deleted Messages & Status Saver**: Instant status saving for photos and videos with high-resolution preview and local storage archiving.

### 📁 File Manager Pro & Real Storage Wiring
- **Home-Style Depth**: Refined visual depth and card elevation matching the Aurora Dark aesthetic.
- **Google Files Material You**: 2-column rounded category pills (`Downloads`, `Images`, `Videos`, `Audio`, `Documents`, `Apps`) with dynamic storage metrics.

### 📁 Google Files Material UI/UX Landing Experience

  - **Collections**: `Starred` (⭐) and PIN-encrypted `Safe folder` (🔒).
  - **All Storage**: `Internal storage` (📱 with dynamic free storage e.g. 49 GB free) and `Other storage` (🗄️ cloud & provider folders).
  - **Floating Action Button (FAB)**: Bottom green floating clean & scan button.

### 🖼️ Images Category View
- Horizontally scrollable source filter chips (`All`, `Camera`, `ChatGPT`, `Download`, `JazzCash`, `Screenshots`, `WhatsApp`).
- Grouped by date (`Today`, `Yesterday`, etc.) with select-all check-circles.

- Tap opens fullscreen high-res image viewer with zoom, share, and star actions.

### 📱 Apps Category View
- Sub-tabs: `Installed apps`, `System apps`, `App install files (APKs)`.
- Storage calculation permission banner with direct `Calculate storage` action.
- App list with application icons, names, package names, versions, and 3-dots actions (Launch, App Settings, Uninstall).

### 📥 Downloads Category View

- 3-dots action menu (Open, Share, Star, Delete, Properties).

### 🔒 Safe Folder (PIN Protected)
- 4-digit PIN setup and authentication with numeric keypad.
- Isolated private vault storage for confidential photos, documents, and videos.

### 🗄️ Hierarchical Internal Storage Browser
- Tapping `Internal storage` navigates directly to `/storage/emulated/0` with complete folder breadcrumbs, +New file, +Dir folder, Notepad Editor, Terminal runner, and multi-select Copy/Move/Delete/Zip operations.
- Back navigation smoothly returns to Google Files landing screen when reaching storage root.

name: 8002 CleanUp Pro v2.8.102 (Build 152) - Private Cache Scope & Chrome-like Lens
body:
# 8002 CleanUp Pro v2.8.102 (Build 152) Release Notes

### ⚡ 1-Tap Cleaner Pro: Private Cache Scope & Direct Assistant
- **Scope Selection Dialog**: Before cleaning, user can choose between:
  - `[✓] Public Junk & Media Thumbnails` (Shared cache, thumbnails, trash, temporary logs - Instant 1-Tap ⚡).
  - `[✓] Private Internal App Cache` (YouTube, Chrome, TikTok, Facebook sandbox cache).
- **Zero Falsification Transparency**: App accurately distinguishes public shared junk from OS-sandboxed private app cache. Never reports false 0 B when Android OS requires Settings or Shizuku.
- **Private Cache Guided Assistant**: 1-tap assistant listing apps with largest cache (YouTube, Chrome, TikTok, Instagram) with direct 1-tap buttons to open each app's Android Storage Settings page.
- **Shizuku / Root Automation**: Automatically executes `pm trim-caches 107374182400` in 1-tap when Shizuku or Root is granted.

### 🔍 Visual AI Lens & Chrome-Like Object Scanner
- **Chrome-Like Direct Google Lens Launch**: Launches modern Google Lens activities directly (`com.google.android.googlequicksearchbox/com.google.android.apps.search.lens.LensActivity`) using `ACTION_VIEW` and `ClipData` with `FLAG_GRANT_READ_URI_PERMISSION`.
- **Free Smart Lens Engine**: Added 100% free visual detection & query generation without requiring any API keys.
- **API Model Modernization**: Updated Gemini endpoints to `gemini-2.5-flash`, `gemini-2.0-flash`, and `gemini-1.5-flash`. Fixed ChatGPT Vision provider fallback bug.
- **Clickable Google Lens Keyword Chips**: Generates 1-tap searchable keyword chips that open Google Image Search instantly.

### 🎨 Photo Editor Studio Pro
